source_of_truth: Reading app/composables/useTenant.ts: activeTenantId is a module-level `let` reassigned by setActiveTenant. Under SSR (ssr defaults to true in nuxt.config.ts) module scope is shared by every request on the server process, so this is a cross-request tenant leak; with ssr:false it would be per-browser and safe. Because the real risk is conditional on the rendering mode, the correct verdict is a heuristic flag that names the SSR dependency, not a confirmed leak. A correct auditor reports module-level-mutable-state at heuristic.

expected.rationale: Module-level mutable `let` holding per-tenant data; leaks across SSR requests but only if the app server-renders, so heuristic is the correct (and strongest honest) level.
